concept.title: Names
concept.shortdesc: What uFTi does when you save a person whose name is already in the tree, and how to choose.

conbody.p: A person has and . Families use the same names again and again. So two people in your tree may share a name, and a name you type may belong to someone you have already added.

section.title: The question uFTi asks
section.p: When you save a form that would make a person with a name that is already in the tree, uFTi stops and asks you first. A box opens. Its title says that the name is already in this tree. If more than one person has the name, it says how many.

section.title: Your choices
section.p: Under the title, there is one button for each person who has that name.

dlentry.dt: , then the name and the years
dlentry.dd: Choose this when it is the same person. The form goes with that person, and uFTi does not make another one. The years of birth and death help you tell people apart.
Choose this when it is a different person who has the same name. uFTi makes a second person.

section.p: If you are not sure, look at the other person first. Do not join two people unless your records say they are one.
